# Quester

## [12.1.5.1](https://github.com/Nevcairiel/Quester/tree/12.1.5.1) (2026-11-18)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Nevcairiel/Quester/compare/12.1.5.0...12.1.5.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Nevcairiel/Quester/releases)

- Fix quests getting pinned as manually tracked after quick progress updates  
- Keep the quest log title decoration and hide unknown quest levels  
- Fix quest levels in chat links showing as 0  
- Keep quests tracked for 3 minutes after making progress on them  
- Add automatic tracking of nearby quests  
    Track quests when the player gets close to their objectives, and untrack  
    them again when moving away. Manually tracked or untracked quests are  
    left alone, and finished quests are only handled by the option to  
    un-track complete quests. Delivery quests without real objectives are  
    tracked near their turn-in.  
- Can't process quests when the tooltip is secret
